description: This file defines a mapping profile class for AutoMapper, configuring object-to-object mappings between domain entities (CatalogItem, CatalogType, CatalogBrand) and their corresponding DTOs in the public API layer.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A subclass of AutoMapper's Profile configuring mappings between domain entities and DTOs.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor establishing the AutoMapper configuration rules for entities to DTOs mappings.
